notes.title: NOW ANNOUNCING SPELLCARD ACADEMY!
notes.content:
I've been working on a new game, a roguelike deckbuilder called Spellcard Academy where you play as a witch mastering weird and wacky schools of magic like Llamamancy!
[previewyoutube=SDX6VI_pDYg;full][/previewyoutube]
A Magical, TCG-Like Deckbuilder
Spellcard Academy is a strategic, "trading-card-game-like" take on roguelike deckbuilders where the player doesn't fight alone, they can summon their own monsters to fight for them. Many monsters have special properties and effects, like "Far Reach" monsters that can attack from all the way in the back row, and "Multiattack" monsters that get to attack more than once each turn.

Each run you build a deck of cards from "packs", with each pack being a school of magic like Spookymancy, Llamamancy, Spicy Spells, or etc. Spellcard Academy features meta progression where new cards, new packs, and new combos to try are unlocked with each subsequent run!

Upcoming News
Spellcard Academy *might* be featured in some upcoming festivals soon, and there will be a demo for you to play in the near future! Please wishlist and follow Spellcard Academy for more updates so you won't miss out!

Cheers & have a fantastic day!
Colton Ramos
Imakeda Games
